name: AgentSession
description: A session representing an AI coding agent's work on an issue or conversation. Agent sessions track the lifecycle of an agent's engagement, from creation through active work to completion or dismissal. Each session is associated with an agent user (the bot), optionally a human creator, an issue, and a comment thread where the agent posts updates. Sessions contain activities that record the agent's observable steps and can be linked to pull requests created during the work.

name: Customer
description: A customer organization tracked in Linear's customer management system. Customers represent external companies or organizations whose product requests and feedback are captured as customer needs, which can be linked to issues and projects. Customers can be associated with domains, external system IDs, Slack channels, and managed by integrations such as Intercom or Salesforce.

fields.name: approximateNeedCount
fields.description: The approximate count of customer needs (requests) associated with this customer. This is a denormalized counter and may not reflect the exact count at all times.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was archived. Null if the entity has not been archived.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: domains
fields.description: The email domains associated with this customer (e.g., 'acme.com'). Used to automatically match incoming requests to this customer. Public email domains (e.g., gmail.com) are not allowed. Domains must be unique across all customers in the workspace.

fields.name: externalIds
fields.description: Identifiers for this customer in external systems (e.g., CRM IDs from Intercom, Salesforce, or HubSpot). Used for matching customers during integration syncs and upsert operations. External IDs must be unique across customers in the workspace.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: integration
fields.description: The integration that manages this customer's data (e.g., Intercom, Salesforce). Null if the customer is not managed by any data source integration.

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.description: URL of the customer's logo image. Null if no logo has been uploaded.

fields.name: mainSourceId
fields.description: The primary external source ID when a customer has data from multiple external systems. Must be one of the values in the externalIds array. Null if the customer has zero or one external source.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The display name of the customer organization.

fields.name: needs
fields.description: The list of customer needs (product requests and feedback) associated with this customer.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The workspace member assigned as the owner of this customer. Null if no owner has been assigned. App users cannot be set as customer owners.

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: The annual revenue generated by this customer. Null if revenue data has not been provided. May be synced from an external data source such as a CRM integration.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The number of employees or seats at the customer organization. Null if size data has not been provided. May be synced from an external data source such as a CRM integration.

fields.name: slackChannelId
fields.description: The ID of the Slack channel linked to this customer for communication. Null if no Slack channel has been associated. Must be unique across all customers in the workspace.

fields.name: slugId
fields.description: A unique, human-readable URL slug for the customer. Automatically generated and used in customer page URLs.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The current lifecycle status of the customer. Defaults to the first status by position when a customer is created without an explicit status.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: The tier or segment assigned to this customer for prioritization (e.g., Enterprise, Pro, Free). Null if no tier has been assigned.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description:
The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated. This is the same as the creation time if the entity hasn't
    been updated after creation.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL of the customer's page in the Linear application.

name: CustomerNeed
description: A customer need represents a specific product request or piece of feedback from a customer. Customer needs serve as the bridge between customer feedback and engineering work by linking a customer to an issue or project, optionally with a comment or attachment providing additional context. Needs can be created manually, from integrations, or from intake sources like email.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was archived. Null if the entity has not been archived.

fields.name: attachment
fields.description: The issue attachment linked to this need. Populated when the need originates from an intake source (e.g., Slack, Intercom) or when a URL is manually provided. Provides a link back to the original source of the customer feedback. Mutually exclusive with projectAttachment.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The body content of the need in Markdown format. Used to capture manual input about needs that cannot be directly tied to an attachment. Null if the need's content comes from an attached source.

fields.name: bodyData
fields.description: [Internal] The body content of the need as a Prosemirror document JSON string. This is the structured representation of the body field, used for rich text rendering in the editor.

fields.name: comment
fields.description: An optional comment providing additional context for this need. Null if the need was not created from or associated with a specific comment.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The effective Markdown content shown for this customer need. Returns the manually stored body when present, otherwise falls back to content extracted from the source attachment. Null if no content is available.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: The user who manually created this customer need. Null for needs created automatically by integrations or intake sources.

fields.name: customer
fields.description: The customer organization this need belongs to. Null if the need has not yet been associated with a customer.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: issue
fields.description: The issue this need is linked to. Either issueId or projectId must be set. When set, the need's projectId is denormalized from the issue's project.

fields.name: originalIssue
fields.description: The issue this customer need was originally created on, before being moved to a different issue or project. Null if the customer need has not been moved from its original location.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Whether the customer need is important or not. 0 = Not important, 1 = Important.

fields.name: project
fields.description: The project this need is linked to. For issue-based needs, this is denormalized from the issue's project. For project-only needs, this is set directly.

fields.name: projectAttachment
fields.description: The project attachment linked to this need. Populated when the need originates from an intake source or when a URL is manually provided for a project-level need. Provides a link back to the original source of the customer feedback. Mutually exclusive with attachment.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description:
The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated. This is the same as the creation time if the entity hasn't
    been updated after creation.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL of the source attachment linked to this need, if any. Returns the URL from either the issue attachment or project attachment. Null if the need has no attached source.

name: Integration
description: An integration with an external service. Integrations connect Linear to tools like Slack, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Figma, Sentry, Zendesk, Intercom, Front, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Google Sheets, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Salesforce, and others. Each integration record represents a single configured connection, scoped to a workspace and optionally to a specific team, project, initiative, or custom view. Personal integrations (e.g., Slack Personal, Jira Personal, GitHub Personal) are scoped to the user who created them.

name: Issue
description: An issue is the core work item in Linear. Issues belong to a team, have a workflow status, can be assigned to users, carry a priority level, and can be organized into projects and cycles. Issues support sub-issues (parent-child hierarchy up to 10 levels deep), labels, due dates, estimates, and SLA tracking. name: PullRequest
description: [Internal] A pull or merge request from a connected version control system (GitHub or GitLab). Pull requests are automatically linked to Linear issues via branch names or commit messages containing issue identifiers. They track the full lifecycle including status, reviewers, checks, and merge state, and are synced bidirectionally with the hosting provider.

name: Release
description: A release that bundles issues together for a software deployment or version. Releases belong to a release pipeline and progress through stages (e.g., planned, started, completed, canceled). Issues are associated with releases via the IssueToRelease join entity, and the release tracks lifecycle timestamps such as when it was started, completed, or canceled.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was archived. Null if the entity has not been archived.

fields.name: autoArchivedAt
fields.description: The time at which the release was automatically archived by the auto pruning process.

fields.name: canceledAt
fields.description: The time at which the release was canceled. Set automatically when the release moves to a canceled stage. Reset to null if the release moves back to a non-canceled stage.

fields.name: commitSha
fields.description: The Git commit SHA associated with this release. Used for SHA-based idempotency when completing releases and for linking releases to specific points in the repository history. Null if the release was created without a commit reference.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: The time at which the release was completed. Set automatically when the release moves to a completed stage. Reset to null if the release moves back to a non-completed stage.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: The user who created the release. Null if the release was created by a non-user context such as an access key or automation.

fields.name: currentProgress
fields.description: The current progress summary for the release, including counts of issues by workflow state type (e.g., completed, in progress, unstarted).

fields.name: description
fields.description: The description of the release in plain text or markdown. Null if no description has been set.

name: SyncedExternalThread
description: A comment thread that is synced with an external source such as Slack, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, or email. Provides information about the external thread's origin, its current sync status, and whether the user has the necessary personal integration connected to participate in the thread.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: A human-readable display name for the thread, derived from the external source. For Slack threads this is the channel name, for Jira it's the issue key, for email it's the sender name and count of other participants.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of this synced external thread. Auto-generated if not provided.

fields.name: isConnected
fields.description: Whether this thread is currently syncing comments bidirectionally with the external service. False if the external entity relation has been removed or if the thread was explicitly unsynced.

fields.name: isPersonalIntegrationConnected
fields.description: Whether the current user has a working personal integration connected for the external service. For example, whether they have connected their personal Jira, GitHub, or Slack account. A connected personal integration may still return false if it has an authentication error.

fields.name: isPersonalIntegrationRequired
fields.description: Whether a connected personal integration is required to post comments in this synced thread. True for Jira and GitHub threads, where comments must be attributed to a specific user in the external system. False for Slack and other services where the workspace integration can post on behalf of users.

fields.name: name
fields.description: A human-readable display name for the external source (e.g., 'Slack', 'Jira', 'GitHub').

fields.name: subType
fields.description: The specific integration service for the external source (e.g., 'slack', 'jira', 'github', 'salesforce'). Null if the source type does not have a sub-type.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The category of the external source (e.g., 'integration' for service integrations, 'email' for email-based threads).

fields.name: url
fields.description: A URL linking to the thread in the external service. For example, a Slack message permalink, a Jira issue URL, or a GitHub issue URL.

name: Team

Teams can also have sub-teams that inherit settings from their parent.

name: Webhook
description: A webhook subscription that sends HTTP POST callbacks to an external URL when events occur in Linear. Webhooks can be scoped to a specific team, multiple teams, or all public teams in the organization. They support filtering by resource type (e.g., Issue, Comment, Project) and can be created either manually by users or automatically by OAuth applications. Each webhook has a signing secret for verifying payload authenticity on the recipient side.

fields.name: allPublicTeams
fields.description: Whether the webhook receives events from all public (non-private) teams in the organization, including teams created after the webhook was set up. When true, the webhook automatically covers new public teams without requiring reconfiguration.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was archived. Null if the entity has not been archived.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: The user who created the webhook.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Whether the webhook is enabled. When disabled, no payloads will be delivered even if matching events occur.

fields.name: failures
fields.description: [INTERNAL] Webhook failure events associated with the webhook (last 50).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: label
fields.description: A human-readable label for the webhook, used for identification in the UI. Null if no label has been set.

fields.name: resourceTypes
fields.description: The resource types this webhook is subscribed to (e.g., 'Issue', 'Comment', 'Project', 'Cycle'). The webhook will only receive payloads for events affecting these resource types.

fields.name: secret
fields.description: A secret token used to sign webhook payloads with HMAC-SHA256, allowing the recipient to verify that the payload originated from Linear and was not tampered with. Automatically generated if not provided during creation.

fields.name: team
fields.description: The single team that the webhook is scoped to. When null, the webhook either targets all public teams (if allPublicTeams is true), multiple specific teams (if teamIds is set), or organization-wide events.

fields.name: teamIds
fields.description: [INTERNAL] An array of team IDs that the webhook is subscribed to. Used to represent a webhook that targets multiple specific teams, potentially in addition to all public teams (when allPublicTeams is also true). Null when the webhook targets a single team via teamId or all public teams only.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description:
The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated. This is the same as the creation time if the entity hasn't
    been updated after creation.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The destination URL where webhook payloads will be sent via HTTP POST. Null for OAuth application webhooks, which use the webhook URL configured on the OAuth client instead.

name: WebhookFailureEvent
description: A record of a failed webhook delivery attempt. Created when a webhook payload could not be successfully delivered to the destination URL, either due to an HTTP error response or a network failure. Each failure event captures the HTTP status code (if available), the response body or error message, and a stable execution ID that is shared across retries of the same delivery.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: executionId
fields.description: A stable identifier for the webhook delivery attempt. This ID remains the same across retries of the same payload, making it useful for correlating multiple failure events that belong to the same logical delivery.

fields.name: httpStatus
fields.description: The HTTP status code returned by the webhook recipient. Null if the request failed before receiving a response (e.g., DNS resolution failure, connection timeout).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: responseOrError
fields.description: The HTTP response body returned by the recipient, or the error message if the request failed before receiving a response. Truncated to 1000 characters.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL that the webhook was trying to push to.

fields.name: webhook
fields.description: The webhook that this failure event is associated with.

name: WorkflowDefinition

Workflows can be scoped to a team, project, cycle, label, custom view, initiative, or user context. They are triggered by entity changes (e.g., issue status change, new comment) and can include conditions that filter which events actually execute the workflow. Activities define the actions taken, such as updating issue properties, sending notifications, or posting to Slack.

fields.description: The name of the state.

fields.name: teamId
fields.description: The team associated with the state.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The workflow state type, which categorizes the state. Valid values: backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled. The type determines how the state is treated in workflow progression and reporting.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: Used in `before` and `after` args

name: WorkflowStateFilter
description: Workflow state filtering options.

fields.name: and
fields.description: Compound filters, all of which need to be matched by the workflow state.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Comparator for the created at date.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Comparator for the workflow state description.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Comparator for the identifier.

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Filters that the workflow states issues must satisfy.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Comparator for the workflow state name.

fields.name: or
fields.description: Compound filters, one of which need to be matched by the workflow state.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Comparator for the workflow state position.

fields.name: team
fields.description: Filters that the workflow states team must satisfy.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Comparator for the workflow state type. Possible values are "triage", "backlog", "unstarted", "started", "completed", "canceled", "duplicate".

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Comparator for the updated at date.

name: WorkflowStatePayload
description: The result of a workflow state mutation, containing the created or updated state and a success indicator.

fields.name: lastSyncId
fields.description: The identifier of the last sync operation.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Whether the operation was successful.

fields.name: workflowState
fields.description: The state that was created or updated.

name: WorkflowStateSort
description: Issue workflow state sorting options.

fields.name: closedIssuesOrderedByRecency
fields.description: Whether to sort closed issues by recency

fields.name: nulls
fields.description: Whether nulls should be sorted first or last

fields.name: order
fields.description: The order for the individual sort

name: WorkflowStateUpdateInput
description: Input for updating an existing workflow state. All fields are optional; only provided fields will be updated. The state type cannot be changed after creation.

fields.description: The color of the state.

fields.description: The description of the state.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the state.

fields.name: position
fields.description: The position of the state.

fields.name: automateTicketReopeningOnCancellation
fields.description: Whether a ticket should be automatically reopened when its linked Linear issue is canceled.

fields.name: automateTicketReopeningOnComment
fields.description: Whether a ticket should be automatically reopened when a comment is posted on its linked Linear issue

fields.name: automateTicketReopeningOnCompletion
fields.description: Whether a ticket should be automatically reopened when its linked Linear issue is completed.

fields.name: automateTicketReopeningOnProjectCancellation
fields.description: Whether a ticket should be automatically reopened when its linked Linear project is canceled.

fields.name: automateTicketReopeningOnProjectCompletion
fields.description: Whether a ticket should be automatically reopened when its linked Linear project is completed.

fields.name: botUserId
fields.description: The ID of the Linear bot user.

fields.name: canReadCustomers
fields.description: [INTERNAL] Temporary flag indicating if the integration has the necessary scopes for Customers

fields.name: disableCustomerRequestsAutoCreation
fields.description: [ALPHA] Whether customer and customer requests should not be automatically created when conversations are linked to a Linear issue.

fields.name: enableAiIntake
fields.description: Whether Linear Agent should be enabled for this integration.

fields.name: enableAiIntakeAttachmentProcessing
fields.description: Whether Linear Agent should process supported attachments from Zendesk tickets during AI intake. When false, attachments are omitted from the prompt.

fields.name: hostMappings
fields.description: The host mappings from Zendesk brands.

fields.name: sendNoteOnComment
fields.description: Whether an internal message should be added when someone comments on an issue.

fields.name: sendNoteOnStatusChange
fields.description: Whether an internal message should be added when a Linear issue changes status (for status types except completed or canceled).

fields.name: subdomain
fields.description: The subdomain of the Zendesk organization being connected.

fields.name: supportsOAuthRefresh
fields.description: [INTERNAL] Flag indicating if the integration supports OAuth refresh tokens

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL of the connected Zendesk organization.
